d:
Senior Associate Editor of The Indian Express, Santosh Singh, explains the current political atmosphere of Bihar elections — the changing strategies of Nitish Kumar, Tejashwi Yadav, and Prashant Kishor.
In this insightful discussion, he breaks down the mood of voters, alliances, caste equations, and leadership challenges ahead of the Bihar Assembly Elections 2025.
Watch this exclusive political analysis to understand how Bihar’s political landscape is shifting and what lies ahead for its key leaders.
Topics Covered:
Bihar Election 2025 political analysis
Nitish Kumar vs Tejashwi Yadav
